mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE status = 1) AS staff, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_dept) AS depts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wf_instance WHERE status = 'RUNNING') AS runningApprovals, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wf_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND assignee_id = #{userId}) AS myTodo, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prj_project WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS activeProjects, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prj_task WHERE status != 'DONE') AS openTasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM att_checkin WHERE check_date = (SELECT MAX(check_date) FROM att_checkin)) AS todayCheckins, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM att_checkin WHERE in_status = 'LATE') AS monthLate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM doc_file) AS docs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oa_notice) AS notices
SELECT check_date AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN in_status = 'LATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late FROM att_checkin GROUP BY check_date ORDER BY check_date
SELECT status AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM prj_task GROUP BY status
SELECT status AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM wf_instance GROUP BY status
SELECT d.dept_name AS label, COUNT(u.id) AS cnt FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.dept_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id, d.dept_name ORDER BY cnt DESC, d.id

SELECT x.biz_type, x.title, x.sort_time, x.ref_id FROM ( SELECT 'APPROVAL' AS biz_type, i.title AS title, CONCAT(i.create_time, '') AS sort_time, i.id AS ref_id FROM wf_instance i JOIN wf_task t ON t.instance_id = i.id WHERE t.assignee_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 'PENDING' AND i.status = 'RUNNING' UNION ALL SELECT 'TASK' AS biz_type, t.title AS title, t.due_date AS sort_time, t.id AS ref_id FROM prj_task t WHERE t.assignee_id = #{userId} AND t.status != 'DONE' ) x ORDER BY x.sort_time LIMIT 8
